verses.geez:
ወሶበ ፡ ሰምዐ ፡ ኢያቢስ ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ አ[ሶ]ር ፡ ለአከ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ኢዮባብ ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ አመሮን ፡ ወኀበ ፡ ንጉሠ ፡
                  ሰሞኣን ፡ ወኀበ ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ አዚፍ ፤
verses.translation: And when Jabis the king of Asor heard, he sent to Jobab king of Maron, and to the king of Symoön, and to the king of Aziph,

translations.lxx: And when Jabis the king of Asor heard, he sent to Jobab king of Maron, and to the king of Symoön, and to the king of Aziph,
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when Jabin king of Hazor had heard those things, that he sent to Jobab king of Madon, and to the king of Shimron, and to the king of Achshaph,
translations.ron: Cum a auzit de aceasta, Iabin, regele Haţorului, a trimis la Iobab, regele Madonului, la regele Şimronului şi la regele Acşafului;

verses.geez:
ወኀበ ፡ ነገሥት ፡ እለ ፡ መንገለ ፡ ሲዶና ፡ እንተ ፡ ተዐቢ ፡ (እንተ ፡) ውስተ ፡ አድባር ፡ ወውስተ ፡ አራባ ፡
                  እንተ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ ኬኔሬት ፡ ወውስተ ፡ አሕቅልት ፡ ወውስተ ፡ ፌናዶር ፤
verses.translation: and to the kings who were by the great Sidon, to the hill country and to Araba opposite Keneroth, and to the plain, and to Phenaeddor,

translations.lxx: and to the kings who were by the great Sidon, to the hill country and to Araba opposite Keneroth, and to the plain, and to Phenaeddor,
translations.kjv: And to the kings that were on the north of the mountains, and of the plains south of Chinneroth, and in the valley, and in the borders of Dor on the west,
translations.ron: La regii cei de la miazănoapte; din munţi, de pe podiş, de la miazăzi de Chinerot, în câmpie şi în ţinutul Dor, la apus;

verses.geez:
ወውስተ ፡ ጰራሊያ ፡ ዘከናአን ፡ ዘመንገለ ፡ ጽባሕ ፡ ወውስተ ፡ ጰራሊያ ፡ ዘአሞሬዎን ፡ ወኤዌዎን ፡ ወኢየቡሴዎን ፡
                  ወፌሬዜዎን ፡ እለ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አድባር ፡ ወኬጤዎን ፡ እለ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አሕቅልት ፡ ወውስተ ፡ መሴውመን ።
verses.translation: and to the Chananites on the coast eastward, and to the Amorites on the coast, and the Chettites, and the Pherezites, and the Jebusites in the mountain, and the Evites, and those dwelling under mount Aermon in the land Massyma.

translations.lxx: and to the Chananites on the coast eastward, and to the Amorites on the coast, and the Chettites, and the Pherezites, and the Jebusites in the mountain, and the Evites, and those dwelling under mount Aermon in the land Massyma.
translations.kjv: And to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, and to the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Jebusite in the mountains, and to the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpeh.
translations.ron: La Canaaneii din răsărit, de pe malul mării; la Amorei, la Hetei, la Ferezei, la Iebuseii din munţi şi la Heveii de sub Hermon, în pământul Miţpa.

verses.geez:
ወወፅኡ ፡ እሙንቱኒ ፡ ወነገሥቶሙኒ ፡ ምስሌሆሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኆጻ ፡ ባሕር ፡ ብዝኆሙ ፡ [ወአፍራስ ፡ ወሰረገላት ፡ ብዙኅ ፡
                  ጥቀ ፡]፡
verses.translation: And they and their kings with them went forth, as the sand of the sea in multitude, and horses, and very many chariots.

translations.lxx: And they and their kings with them went forth, as the sand of the sea in multitude, and horses, and very many chariots.
translations.kjv: And they went out, they and all their hosts with them, much people, even as the sand that is upon the sea shore in multitude, with horses and chariots very many.
translations.ron: Şi au ieşit aceştia împreună cu regii lor, popor mult la număr, ca nisipul de la marginea mării, şi cai şi care de război foarte multe.

verses.geez:
ወተጋብኡ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ነገሥቶሙ ፡ ወመጽኡ ፡ ኅቡረ ፡ ወተአኅዝዎሙ ፡ ይትቃተልዎሙ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ በኀበ ፡ ማየ ፡ መሮን
                  ።
verses.translation: And all the kings assembled in person, and came to the same place, and encamped at the waters of Maron to war with Israel.

translations.lxx: And all the kings assembled in person, and came to the same place, and encamped at the waters of Maron to war with Israel.
translations.kjv: And when all these kings were met together, they came and pitched together at the waters of Merom, to fight against Israel.
translations.ron: Şi s-au adunat toţi regii aceştia şi au tăbărât împreună la apele Merom, ca să se lupte cu Israel.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለኢየሱስ ፡ ኢትፍራህ ፡ እምቅድመ ፡ ገጾሙ ፡ እስመ ፡ ጌሠመ ፡ በዛቲ ፡ [ጊዜ ፡] አነ ፡
                  ኣገብኦሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይትቀተሉ ፡ በቅድመ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወለአፍራሲሆሙኒ ፡ ምትርዎን ፡ ሥረዊሆን ፡ ወሰረገላቲሆሙኒ ፡ አውዕዩ ፡
                  በእሳት ።
verses.translation: And the Lord said to Joshua, Be not afraid of them, for to-morrow at this time I will put them to flight before Israel: thou shalt hough their horses, and burn their chariots with fire.

translations.lxx: And the Lord said to Joshua, Be not afraid of them, for to-morrow at this time I will put them to flight before Israel: thou shalt hough their horses, and burn their chariots with fire.
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Be not afraid because of them: for to morrow about this time will I deliver them up all slain before Israel: thou shalt hough their horses, and burn their chariots with fire.
translations.ron: Domnul însă a zis: "Nu te teme de faţa lor, căci mâine pe vremea aceasta îi voi da pe toţi aceia fiilor lui Israel ca să-i ucidă; cailor lor să le tai vinele picioarelor, iar carele să le arzi cu foc".

verses.geez:
ወሖሩ ፡ ኢየሱስ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ መስተቃትላን ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ማየ ፡ መሮን ፡ ወአውገብዎሙ ፡ ወወረዱ ፡
                  ላዕሌሆሙ ፡ እምነ ፡ አድባር ።
verses.translation: And Joshua and all the men of war came upon them at the water of Maron suddenly; and they attacked them in the hill country.

translations.lxx: And Joshua and all the men of war came upon them at the water of Maron suddenly; and they attacked them in the hill country.
translations.kjv: So Joshua came, and all the people of war with him, against them by the waters of Merom suddenly; and they fell upon them.
translations.ron: Atunci Iosua împreună cu tot poporul bun de luptă a ieşit fără de veste înaintea lor, la apele Merom şi a năvălit în munţi asupra lor.

verses.geez:
ወአግብኦሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ውስተ ፡ እዴሆሙ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ ወዴገንዎሙ ፡ (ወ)እንዘ ፡ ይቀትልዎሙ ፡ እስከ ፡ ሲዶና ፡
                  ዐቢይ ፡ ወእስከ ፡ መሴሮን ፡ ወእስከ ፡ አሕቅልተ ፡ መሶኅ ፡ በመንገለ ፡ ጽባሒሁ ፡ ወቀተልዎሙ ፡ ኢያትረፉ ፡ እምኔሆሙ ፡
                  ነፋጺተ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord delivered them into the power of Israel; and they smote them and pursued them to great Sidon, and to Maseron, and to the plains of Massoch eastward; and they destroyed them till there was not one of them left that survived.

translations.lxx: And the Lord delivered them into the power of Israel; and they smote them and pursued them to great Sidon, and to Maseron, and to the plains of Massoch eastward; and they destroyed them till there was not one of them left that survived.
translations.kjv: And the LORD delivered them into the hand of Israel, who smote them, and chased them unto great Zidon, and unto Misrephothmaim, and unto the valley of Mizpeh eastward; and they smote them, until they left them none remaining.
translations.ron: Şi i-a dat pe ei Domnul în mâinile lui Israel şi i-a lovit şi i-a urmărit până la Sidonul cel Mare, până la Misrefot-Maim şi până în valea Miţpa, la răsărit, şi i-a ucis până n-a scăpat nimeni.

verses.geez:
ወገብሮሙ ፡ ኢየሱስ ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ መተረ ፡ ሥረዊሆን ፡ ለአፍራሲሆሙ ፡ ወሰረገላቲሆሙኒ ፡ አውዐየ ፡
                  በእሳት ።
verses.translation: And Joshua did to them, as the Lord commanded him: he houghed their horses, and burned their chariots with fire.

translations.lxx: And Joshua did to them, as the Lord commanded him: he houghed their horses, and burned their chariots with fire.
translations.kjv: And Joshua did unto them as the LORD bade him: he houghed their horses, and burnt their chariots with fire.
translations.ron: Şi a făcut Iosua cu ei cum îi zisese Domnul: cailor lor le-a tăiat vinele picioarelor şi carele lor le-a ars cu foc.

verses.geez:
ወተመይጠ ፡ ኢየሱስ ፡ በእማንቱ ፡ መዋዕል ፡ ወነሥኣ ፡ ለአሶር ፡ ወለንጉሣ ፡ እስመ ፡ አሶር ፡ ቀዲሙ ፡ ምኵናኒሆሙ ፡
                  ይእቲ ፡ ለኵሎሙ ፡ እሉ ፡ ነገሥት ።
verses.translation: And Joshua returned at that time, and took Asor and her king; now Asor in former time was the chief of these kingdoms.

translations.lxx: And Joshua returned at that time, and took Asor and her king; now Asor in former time was the chief of these kingdoms.
translations.kjv: And Joshua at that time turned back, and took Hazor, and smote the king thereof with the sword: for Hazor beforetime was the head of all those kingdoms.
translations.ron: Tot atunci întorcându-se, Iosua a luat Haţorul şi pe regele lui l-a omorât cu sabia. Haţorul fusese până atunci capul tuturor regatelor acestora.

verses.geez:
ወቀተሉ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘመንፈስ ፡ ዘውስቴታ ፡ በኀፂን ፡ ወአጥፍእዎሙ ፡ ለኵሎሙ ፡ እስከ ፡ ኢያትረፉ ፡ ውስቴታ ፡ ዘመንፈስ
                  ፡ ወአውዐያ ፡ ለአሶር ፡ በእሳት ፡ ወለኵሉ ፡ አህጉረ ፡ ነገሥት ።
verses.translation: And they slew with the sword all that breathed in it, and utterly destroyed them all, and there was no living thing left in it; and they burnt Asor with fire.

translations.lxx: And they slew with the sword all that breathed in it, and utterly destroyed them all, and there was no living thing left in it; and they burnt Asor with fire.
translations.kjv: And they smote all the souls that were therein with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying them: there was not any left to breathe: and he burnt Hazor with fire.
translations.ron: Şi a ucis toată suflarea din acesta cu sabia, dând toate pieirii; şi n-a rămas nici un suflet, iar Haţorul l-a ars cu foc.

verses.geez:
ወነሥኦሙ ፡ ኢየሱስ ፡ ለነገሥቶሙ ፡ ወቀተሎሙ ፡ በኀፂን ፡ ወሠረዎሙ ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ቍልዔሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር
                  ።
verses.translation: And Joshua took all the cities of the kingdoms, and their kings, and slew them with the edge of the sword; and utterly slew them, as Moses the servant of the Lord commanded.

translations.lxx: And Joshua took all the cities of the kingdoms, and their kings, and slew them with the edge of the sword; and utterly slew them, as Moses the servant of the Lord commanded.
translations.kjv: And all the cities of those kings, and all the kings of them, did Joshua take, and smote them with the edge of the sword, and he utterly destroyed them, as Moses the servant of the LORD commanded.
translations.ron: Astfel a luat Iosua toate cetăţile regatelor acestora şi pe toţi regii lor i-a ucis cu sabia, dându-i pieirii, cum poruncise Moise, sluga Domnului.

verses.geez: ወባዕደሰ ፡ አህጉረ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘአድያም ፡ ኢያውዐዩ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ እንበለ ፡ አሶር ፡ ባሕቲታ ፡ ዘአውዐዩ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.translation: But all the walled cities Israel burnt not; but Israel burnt Asor only.

translations.lxx: But all the walled cities Israel burnt not; but Israel burnt Asor only.
translations.kjv: But as for the cities that stood still in their strength, Israel burned none of them, save Hazor only; that did Joshua burn.
translations.ron: Iar cetăţile cele întărite nu le-a ars Israel, afară de Haţor, pe care l-a ars Iosua.

verses.geez:
ወበርበርዋ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ለርእሶሙ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ በርበራ ፡ ወሎሙሰ ፡ ሠረውዎሙ ፡ ለኵሎሙ ፡ እስከ ፡ አጥፍእዎሙ ፡
                  በአፈ ፡ ኀፂን ፡ ወኢያትረፉ ፡ እምኔሆሙ ፡ ወኢአሐደ ፡ ዘመንፈስ ።
verses.translation: And the children of Israel took all its spoils to themselves; and they slew all the men with the edge of the sword, until he destroyed them; they left not one of them breathing.

translations.lxx: And the children of Israel took all its spoils to themselves; and they slew all the men with the edge of the sword, until he destroyed them; they left not one of them breathing.
translations.kjv: And all the spoil of these cities, and the cattle, the children of Israel took for a prey unto themselves; but every man they smote with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them, neither left they any to breathe.
translations.ron: Toată prada cetăţilor acestora şi toate vitele le-au luat fiii lui Israel pentru ei, iar pe oameni i-au ucis cu sabia, i-au dat blestemului şi n-au lăsat din ei nici un suflet.

verses.geez:
በከመ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ቍልዔሁ ፡ ወሙሴ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ ለኢየሱስ ፡ ወከማሁ ፡ ገብረ ፡ ኢየሱስ ፡
                  ወኢኀደገ ፡ ወኢምንተ ፡ እምነ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘአዘዞ ፡ ሙሴ ።
verses.translation: As the Lord commanded his servant Moses, even so Moses commanded Joshua; and so Joshua did, he transgressed no precept of all that Moses commanded him.

translations.lxx: As the Lord commanded his servant Moses, even so Moses commanded Joshua; and so Joshua did, he transgressed no precept of all that Moses commanded him.
translations.kjv: As the LORD commanded Moses his servant, so did Moses command Joshua, and so did Joshua; he left nothing undone of all that the LORD commanded Moses.
translations.ron: Precum poruncise Domnul lui Moise, sluga Sa, şi cum poruncise şi Moise lui Iosua, aşa a făcut Iosua: nu s-a abătut de la nimic, nici de la un cuvânt din câte poruncise Domnul lui Moise.

verses.geez:
ወነሥአ ፡ ኢየሱስ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ደወለ ፡ ምድሮሙ ፡ ዘመንገለ ፡ አድባር ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ምድረ ፡ አዴብ ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ምድረ ፡
                  ጎሶም ፡ ወአሕቅልቲሃ ፡ ወዘመንገለ ፡ ዐረቢሃ ፡ ወደብረ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወታሕትየኒ ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ ዘመንገለ ፡ ደብር ፤
verses.translation: And Joshua took all the hill country, and all the land of Nageb, and all the land of Gosom, and the plain country, and that toward the west, and the mountain of Israel and the low country by the mountain;

translations.lxx: And Joshua took all the hill country, and all the land of Nageb, and all the land of Gosom, and the plain country, and that toward the west, and the mountain of Israel and the low country by the mountain;
translations.kjv: So Joshua took all that land, the hills, and all the south country, and all the land of Goshen, and the valley, and the plain, and the mountain of Israel, and the valley of the same;
translations.ron: Şi aşa a luat Iosua toată ţara aceea de sus şi tot ţinutul Negheb, tot ţinutul Goşen şi ţinuturile de jos, şesul şi muntele lui Israel şi locurile joase de pe lângă munte,

verses.geez:
እምነ ፡ ደብረ ፡ ኤኬል ፡ ወየዐርግ ፡ እስከ ፡ ሴይር ፡ ወእስከ ፡ በለገድ ፡ ወአሕቅልተ ፡ ሊባኖስ ፡ ዘመንገለ ፡ ደብረ
                  ፡ አኤርሞን ፡ ወአኀዞሙ ፡ ለኵሎሙ ፡ ነገሥቶሙ ፡ ወቀተሎሙ ፡ ወአጥፍኦሙ ።
verses.translation: from the mountain of Chelcha, and that which goes up to Seir, and as far as Balagad, and the plains of Libanus, under mount Aermon; and he took all their kings, and destroyed, and slew them.

translations.lxx: from the mountain of Chelcha, and that which goes up to Seir, and as far as Balagad, and the plains of Libanus, under mount Aermon; and he took all their kings, and destroyed, and slew them.
translations.kjv: Even from the mount Halak, that goeth up to Seir, even unto Baalgad in the valley of Lebanon under mount Hermon: and all their kings he took, and smote them, and slew them.
translations.ron: De la Muntele Pele, care se întinde spre Seir, până la Baal-Gad din valea Libanului, la poalele Hermonului; a luat pe toţi regii lor şi i-a lovit şi i-a ucis.

verses.geez: ወጕንዱየ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ነበረ ፡ ኢየሱስ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እሉ ፡ ነገሥት ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይትቃተሎሙ ።
verses.translation: And for many days Joshua waged war with these kings.

translations.lxx: And for many days Joshua waged war with these kings.
translations.kjv: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.
translations.ron: Dar Iosua a purtat multă vreme război cu toţi regii aceştia.

verses.geez: ወአልቦ ፡ ሀገረ ፡ እንተ ፡ ኢነሥኡ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ኵሎን ፡ ነሥእዎን ፡ በቀትል ።
verses.translation: And there was no city which Israel took not; they took all in war.

translations.lxx: And there was no city which Israel took not; they took all in war.
translations.kjv: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, save the Hivites the inhabitants of Gibeon: all other they took in battle.
translations.ron: Şi n-a fost cetate pe care să n-o fi luat cu fiii lui Israel; toate le-au luat cu război, afară de Ghibeon în care locuiau Heveii;

verses.geez:
እስመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አጽንዖሙ ፡ ልቦሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቀትል ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ ከመ ፡ ይሠርውዎሙ ፡ ወከመ ፡ ኢይምሐርዎሙ
                  ፡ አላ ፡ ከመ ፡ ያጥፍእዎሙ ፡ ቦከመ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ።
verses.translation: For it was of the Lord to harden their hearts to go forth to war against Israel, that they might be utterly destroyed, that mercy should not be granted to them, but that they should be utterly destroyed, as the Lord said to Moses.

translations.lxx: For it was of the Lord to harden their hearts to go forth to war against Israel, that they might be utterly destroyed, that mercy should not be granted to them, but that they should be utterly destroyed, as the Lord said to Moses.
translations.kjv: For it was of the LORD to harden their hearts, that they should come against Israel in battle, that he might destroy them utterly, and that they might have no favour, but that he might destroy them, as the LORD commanded Moses.
translations.ron: Căci aşa a fost de la Domnul, ca să-şi învârtoşeze inima lor şi să întâmpine pe Israel cu război, ca să fie daţi pieirii şi ca să nu găsească milă, ci să fie nimiciţi, cum poruncise Domnul lui Moise.

verses.geez:
ወሖረ ፡ ኢየሱስ ፡ በእማንቱ ፡ መዋዕል ፡ ወአጥፍኦሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አቂም ፡ እለ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አድባር ፡ እምነ ፡
                  ኬብሮን ፡ ወእምነ ፡ ዳቤር ፡ ወእምነ ፡ አናቦት ፡ ወእምውስተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ ወእምነ ፡ አድባረ ፡ ይሁዳ
                  ፡ ምስለ ፡ አህጉሮሙ ፡ ወአጥፍኦሙ ፡ ኢየሱስ ።
verses.translation: And Joshua came at that time, and utterly destroyed the Enakim out of the hill country, from Chebron and from Dabir, and from Anaboth, and from all the race of Israel, and from all the mountain of Juda with their cities; and Joshua utterly destroyed them.

translations.lxx: And Joshua came at that time, and utterly destroyed the Enakim out of the hill country, from Chebron and from Dabir, and from Anaboth, and from all the race of Israel, and from all the mountain of Juda with their cities; and Joshua utterly destroyed them.
translations.kjv: And at that time came Joshua, and cut off the Anakims from the mountains, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the mountains of Judah, and from all the mountains of Israel: Joshua destroyed them utterly with their cities.
translations.ron: Apoi a venit Iosua în vremea aceea şi a lovit pe toţi Anachimii de la munte, din Hebron, din Debir, din Anab, din toţi munţii lui Iuda şi din toţi munţii lui Israel şi i-a dat Iosua nimicirii împreună cu cetăţile lor.

verses.geez:
ወኢያትረፈ ፡ እምኔሆሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አቂም ፡ እምውስተ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ እንበለ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጋዜ ፡ ወውስተ ፡ [ጌት
                  ፡ ወ]አሴዶ ፡ ዘተርፉ ።
verses.translation: There was not any one left of the Enakim by the children of Israel, only there was left of them in Gaza, and in Gath, and in Aseldo.

translations.lxx: There was not any one left of the Enakim by the children of Israel, only there was left of them in Gaza, and in Gath, and in Aseldo.
translations.kjv: There was none of the Anakims left in the land of the children of Israel: only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, there remained.
translations.ron: Şi n-a rămas niciunul din Anachimi în pământul fiilor lui Israel, ci numai în Gaza, în Gat şi în Aşdod au rămas din ei.

verses.geez:
ወነሥአ ፡ ኢየሱስ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ምድሮሙ ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወወሀቦሙ ፡ ኢየሱስ ፡ ርስቶሙ ፡
                  [ለእስራኤል ፡ ዘከመ ፡] ከፈሎሙ ፡ በበ ፡ ነገዶሙ ፡ ወአዕረፈት ፡ እንከ ፡ ምድር ፡ እምነ ፡ ቀትል ።
verses.translation: And Joshua took all the land, as the Lord commanded Moses; and Joshua gave them for an inheritance to Israel by division according to their tribes; and the land ceased from war.

translations.lxx: And Joshua took all the land, as the Lord commanded Moses; and Joshua gave them for an inheritance to Israel by division according to their tribes; and the land ceased from war.
translations.kjv: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that the LORD said unto Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance unto Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. And the land rested from war.
translations.ron: Aşa a luat Iosua tot pământul, cum poruncise Domnul lui Moise şi l-a dat Iosua de moştenire lui Israel, împărţindu-l între seminţiile lor. Şi s-a liniştit pământul de război.
